clips.send: Someone on daily Tylenol or Advil for aches sends it to their spouse before the next refill - the anger of learning the pill itself may be feeding the problem.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau's warning: your own medicine cabinet may be part of the problem.

His point: everyday over-the-counter pills like Tylenol, Advil and Dramamine can drain the body of magnesium, calcium, vitamin E and omega-3 - and magnesium is one of the most common deficiencies behind high blood pressure.

His own fix: a full-spectrum vitamin E with tocotrienols, alongside magnesium and calcium in the right ratio.

What's sitting in your own medicine cabinet right now?
